learning_outcomes.text: Explain the purpose and scope of HIPAA and who is required to comply
Describe the Privacy Rule and how protected health information (PHI) may be used and disclosed
Describe the Security Rule safeguards: administrative, physical and technical
Identify core obligations such as minimum necessary, patient rights and breach notification
Recognise everyday compliance risks and the role of policies and workforce training

integrative_case: A small practice is onboarding a vendor that will process patient data on its behalf. Classify the relationship, determine what written agreement is required, apply the minimum-necessary principle to the data shared, outline the steps if that data were later lost, and draft a short staff reminder, all at an overview level and noting where qualified legal counsel must be involved.
version_basis: Mastemy design. This is an educational overview of United States HIPAA concepts; it is not legal advice and carries no official HIPAA training certification. There is no issuer syllabus or topic weighting, so module structure and weights are Mastemy design assumptions and must be confirmed against the current HIPAA regulations and organisational policy at blueprint review.
